# HEM v0.7.5b3 — Target and output on the same trend graph

This beta places the recorded target and controller output together in the same graph, so their relationship is visible directly alongside the measured conditions.

- Measurement, historical targets, HEM demand and reported device output share one plotting area and one time axis.
- Measurements and targets retain the left scale in their physical unit. Demand and output use a clearly identified right-hand percentage or On/Off scale.
- The legend distinguishes each controller and the measurement, target, demand and reported-output lines. One cursor inspects their values at the same time.
- Keeps target and output transitions individually inspectable, including changes immediately before a recorded sensor reading, without trapping keyboard navigation on the neighboring reading.
- Target ranges, recorded changes, unavailable intervals and restart gaps keep their existing meaning. Output percentages do not alter the measurement scale.
- Keeps the existing recorded history from v0.7.5b2, including after Home Assistant restarts. Older target and output values are not reconstructed from current settings.

The change affects trend presentation. Existing controller decisions and historical data collection remain compatible.

Update through HACS with beta releases enabled, restart Home Assistant to load the integration version, and refresh the dashboard to load the updated card.
